point: Retraining a 50K BPE vocabulary on PubMed abstracts and switching to whitespace-only pre-tokenization cuts tokens per abstract by about 21% compared with Ettin's tokenizer, while retraining the table alone saves only 8%. This is a token-count result only, and no model has been trained yet.
